title: Clarinetist Bob Young of the Silas Green show
summary: He praises Bob Young of Bolivar, Tennessee for playing clarinet concertos.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: And with the Silas Green Minstrel I met a very fine clarinetist, one of the great clarinetists of the race at that time. His name was Bob Young. Bob Young was from Bolivar, Tennessee. That's a little town a few miles below Jackson, Tennessee, between Jackson and Holly Spring, Mississippi, but still in Tennessee.

This man played all of the clarinet concertos and whatnot. And he played them out of this world. I had never heard such music played by individuals in all my life at that time. It was a great experience traveling around with Johnnie Y Brown and his Playtone Orchestra.
